distributionPolicy: Companion skills are installed independently as siblings and are never vendored into video-reverse-engineer.

conditionalSkills.name: script-aligned-subtitles
conditionalSkills.when: An approved or locked script must remain the canonical caption text.

conditionalSkills.name: seedance-video-director
conditionalSkills.when: The user requests generated photoreal media for reconstruction slots.

conditionalSkills.name: qishui-ad-orchestrator
conditionalSkills.when: The source or target is a Qishui Music advertisement.

onDemandSkills.name: hyperframes-keyframes
onDemandSkills.when: Advanced keyframes, paths, masks, morphs, FLIP, or 3D motion are authored.

onDemandSkills.name: hyperframes-media
onDemandSkills.when: The reconstruction modifies or generates audio, captions, or other media.

onDemandSkills.name: hyperframes-registry
onDemandSkills.when: A registry block or component is installed.

onDemandSkills.name: media-use
onDemandSkills.when: New BGM, SFX, image, or icon assets must be resolved and frozen.

runtime.nodeOwner: Target project package.json or a compatible project-local harness
runtime.optionalCredential: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is required only when video-use must acquire a new Scribe transcript.
